files.role: Package marker for the backend module; no runtime logic.
FastAPI application factory: configures CORS (GET POST only), attaches platform middleware, registers food and report routers, initialises the DB connection pool on startup.

methods.name: on_startup
methods.purpose: Calls init_pool(); logs ready or logs error and continues. No init_schema call — schema is pre-provisioned.

files.role: Postgres connection pool using psycopg2-binary. Reads ATLAS_PG_* env vars (DATABASE_URL fallback). Exposes init_pool() and get_db() context manager.

methods.name: init_pool
methods.purpose: Creates a SimpleConnectionPool(minconn=1, maxconn=5) using the DSN built from ATLAS_PG_* env vars; stores it in module-level _pool.

methods.name: get_db
methods.purpose: Context manager: checks out a connection from _pool, yields it, rolls back on exception, and returns it to the pool in the finally block.

methods.name: _build_url
methods.purpose: Returns DATABASE_URL env var if set, otherwise constructs a postgresql:// DSN from ATLAS_PG_USER, ATLAS_PG_PASSWORD, ATLAS_PG_HOST, ATLAS_PG_PORT, ATLAS_PG_DB.

files.role: Package marker for the routers sub-package; no runtime logic.
Sprint 01 intake endpoints: GET /api/food/template, POST /api/food/validate, POST /api/food/meals. Unchanged in Sprint 02.

methods.name: get_template
methods.purpose: GET /api/food/template — returns the hardcoded canonical meal JSON template string as text/plain.

methods.name: validate_meal
methods.purpose: POST /api/food/validate — reads raw request body, calls _validate_and_normalise(), returns HTTP 200 with {preview: <normalised_dict>} on success or ApiError (HTTP 422) on any validation failure.

methods.name: commit_meal
methods.purpose: POST /api/food/meals — reads raw request body, calls _validate_and_normalise(), inserts one row into foodtracker.food_logs via get_db(), wraps the inserted row in a Dataset using MEAL_SCHEMA and returns HTTP 200. Returns ApiError HTTP 422 on validation failure, ApiError HTTP 400 on DB_CONSTRAINT, ApiError HTTP 500 via install_exception_handlers on unexpected errors.

methods.name: _validate_and_normalise
methods.purpose: Decodes raw bytes as JSON, runs all field validation checks in order, applies defaults and normalisation. Returns (normalised_dict, None) on success or (None, error_dict) on failure. No HTTP coupling.

files.role: Sprint 02 reporting endpoint: GET /api/food/report. Contains REPORT_SCHEMA constant, the ReportQuery dataclass, and private helpers for param validation, bucket computation, DB query, and zero-fill. No shared state with food.py.

methods.name: get_report
methods.purpose: GET /api/food/report — validates query params via _parse_report_params(), then orchestrates steps in order: for scope=all_time+aggregated, calls _query_logs() first, then passes db_rows into _compute_buckets(); for all other scope+mode combinations, calls _compute_buckets() first then _query_logs(). Calls _zero_fill() to merge results, then returns Dataset. Returns ApiError HTTP 422 for invalid params, ApiError HTTP 500 via install_exception_handlers on unexpected errors.

methods.name: __init__
methods.purpose: Value object holding validated scope, period_key, and mode. Constructed only by _parse_report_params() after all validation passes.

methods.name: _parse_report_params
methods.purpose: Validates scope against VALID_SCOPES, validates mode against VALID_MODES, rejects mode=aggregated when scope=week (INVALID_PARAM), validates period_key format matches scope using regex (INVALID_PERIOD_KEY if mismatch, INVALID_PARAM if required but absent). Returns (ReportQuery, None) on success or (None, error_dict) on failure.

methods.name: _compute_buckets
methods.purpose: Returns (ordered_bucket_ids, bucket_label_map) for the given ReportQuery. Enumerates every expected bucket in the period: daily mode→one per calendar day (for all_time+daily returns empty list and empty dict — passthrough handled by _zero_fill), aggregated mode→sub-period labels per bucket rules. For scope=all_time+aggregated, db_rows is required (must not be None): bucket_ids are the distinct year keys present in db_rows, sorted ascending. For all other scope+mode combinations, db_rows is unused. bucket_label_map maps bucket_id to its display string.

methods.name: _build_where_clause
methods.purpose: Returns (sql_fragment, params) for the WHERE clause that restricts foodtracker.food_logs to the selected period. all_time returns empty fragment. Other scopes compute inclusive start and exclusive end timestamps from period_key.

methods.name: _build_group_key_expr
methods.purpose: Returns the SQL expression for the GROUP BY key column, matching the bucket_id format for the given scope+mode (e.g., "to_char(logged_at,'YYYY-MM-DD')" for daily, "to_char(logged_at,'YYYY-MM')" for year+aggregated, "to_char(logged_at,'IYYY-\"W\"IW')" for month+aggregated ISO week key). The month+aggregated expression must use IYYY (ISO year) and IW (ISO week number 01-53), NOT WW (which is non-ISO and will produce bucket ids that do not match the YYYY-WNN format enumerated in _compute_buckets).

methods.name: _query_logs
methods.purpose: Executes SELECT with GROUP BY SUM(kcal), SUM(protein_g), SUM(carbs_g), SUM(fat_g), SUM(fiber_g) against foodtracker.food_logs for the given ReportQuery. Returns a dict mapping bucket_id string → {kcal, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, fiber_g}.

methods.name: _zero_fill
methods.purpose: Merges the ordered bucket_ids list with db_rows. Normal path (bucket_ids non-empty): for each bucket_id, if present in db_rows use those metric values; otherwise emit a row with all metrics = 0. Attaches bucket_label from label_map. Passthrough path (bucket_ids empty — the all_time+daily case only): emit one row per entry in db_rows, sorted ascending by bucket_id. For each passthrough row, derive bucket_label as the day-of-month integer string from the YYYY-MM-DD bucket_id (e.g., '2025-03-07' → '7'); label_map is empty in this case and must not be consulted. Returns ordered list of Dataset row dicts with keys: id, bucket_label, kcal, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, fiber_g.

methods.name: _build_report_label
methods.purpose: Returns the human-readable DatasetMeta.label string for the given ReportQuery, e.g. 'March 2025 — Daily', 'All Time — Aggregated', '2025 — Daily'.

files.role: Side-effect-only registration module. Calls AppRegistry.register({...}) at module scope. Sprint 02 adds the Report nav item (order 2) to mobilePrimaryNav and desktopNav. Has no exports of any kind.

Top-level React entry for the FoodTracker shell slot. Sets up two routes: /food → FoodIntake (Sprint 01, unchanged), /food/report → ReportPage (Sprint 02). The route for /food must use path='/food' (not path='/*').

methods.name: default
methods.purpose: Default export consumed by the shell lazy import in shellConfig.ts. Renders a React Router <Routes> with <Route path='/food' element={<FoodIntake />} /> and <Route path='/food/report' element={<ReportPage />} />.

methods.name: FoodIntake
methods.purpose: Sprint 01 three-state meal intake flow (idle | preview | success). Unchanged in Sprint 02.

files.role: Sprint 02 report screen. Owns page-level scope/period/mode/navStack state, fetches GET /api/food/report, and renders two independently configured chart panels.

methods.name: ReportPage
methods.purpose: Top-level report page component. Manages scope (string), period_key (string | null), mode ('aggregated' | 'daily'), navStack ({scope, period_key, mode}[]), isLoading (boolean), error (ApiError | null), currentDataset (Dataset | null). Fetches on mount and on scope/period_key/mode change. Renders scope selector, mode selector (hidden for week scope), back button (enabled when navStack non-empty), and two ChartPanel instances.

methods.name: ChartPanel
methods.purpose: Renders one chart panel with an independent metric selector and a BarChart over the provided Dataset rows. Local state: selectedMetric (string, initialised from defaultMetric). BarChartMapping: {x: 'bucket_label', y: selectedMetric, aggregation: 'sum'}. Calls onDrillDown(bucketId) when a bar is clicked and isDrillable is true. isDrillable is true when the parent ReportPage is in aggregated mode.

methods.name: _currentPeriodKey
methods.purpose: Returns the period_key string for the system-current period of the given scope (e.g., scope='month' → current 'YYYY-MM', scope='year' → current 'YYYY', scope='week' → current 'YYYY-WNN', scope='all_time' → null).
